fixtureCases.creation: Explorer creation, troop payment and occupancy
fixtureCases.travel: Known and unknown surface travel, stamina and food
fixtureCases.surface: Original surface pool: empty tile, guarded mine with production, hyperstructure and surroundings
fixtureCases.ethereal: Spire entry with Essence payment, stride-15 exploration and guarded Bitcoin discovery
fixtureCases.production: Read-only production view, settlement and repeated settlement
fixtureCases.battle: Surface combat, explorer/resource deletion and freed occupancy
fixtureCases.ethereal_battle: Ethereal combat with the original two rolls
fixtureCases.rejections: Unauthorized actor, occupied destination, resource spending and expired-game rollback
fixtureCases.ownership: Structure and agent transfers, faith accrual, authorization and time boundaries
fixtureCases.ownership_rejections: Village, mode, season boundaries, controller and domain authorization
fixtureCases.ownership_faith: Faith winner ties, duplicate winners, disabled accrual and atomic late failure
fixtureCases.name: Naming with an owned-structure witness: set, overwrite, clear, non-owner rejection and after-end renaming.
fixtureCases.structure: Realm upgrades consume the immutable recipes, update level and troop limits and preserve tile facts; rejected payments roll back all spending.
fixtureCases.structure_rejections: Reject non-settlement upgrades, villages at their configured maximum and pre-start upgrades without changing gameplay facts; wonder realms keep their tile category.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement: Settle with and without immediate troop grants, provision once, reject repeat provisioning, and retain the same troops, buildings, production and balances.
fixtureCases.blitz_entry_rejections: Empty name, opening and closing timestamps, full registration, repeated player and incomplete reservations; all rejected gameplay facts remain unchanged.
fixtureCases.blitz_entry_ledger: A missing registration entitlement rejects, then the same player settles after the bound owner receives the entitlement.
fixtureCases.blitz_cosmetics: Enabled cosmetics preserve the token limit, ownership, nonzero attributes and repeated token ids. Lock timing and retained admission facts follow the separate behaviour rulings.
fixtureCases.blitz_cosmetics_disabled: Disabled cosmetics ignore token eligibility and count, as the pinned rules do.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_displacement: A blocking explorer moves to the first free neighbour without charging movement costs; compare troops, resources, home roster and both tiles.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_blocked: An explorer blocked on all six sides is deleted with its resource facts and removed from its home roster.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_agent_blocked: A surrounded agent is deleted with its resources and ownership row, and the current agent population decreases exactly once.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_occupied: A structure occupying the selected settlement rejects the complete action without partial entry, placement or pool changes.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_modes: Two three-realm settlements preserve selected coordinates, realm order, pool swap removal and remaining candidate locations.
fixtureCases.blitz_settlement_duel: Both players in two-player mode receive the same ordered realm locations and exhaust the same pool.
fixtureCases.blitz_reservations: Reserve the original coordinates without entity ids, enforce mode and clock guards, stop at the completed cursor, and materialize each reserved hyperstructure once.
fixtureCases.season_settlement: Open-entry players draw canonical traits without replacement, settle through the same pool and receive the same immediate troops, production and starting resources; compare all touched facts after each action.
fixtureCases.season_settlement_dev: Explicit canonical realm selection requires development mode, skips ledger and one-entry reservation, permits successive distinct selections, rejects allocated and out-of-range ids, and preserves wonder tiles and metadata.
fixtureCases.season_settlement_ledger: Missing entitlement rejects; a season entitlement settles with recorded realm metadata; a second owner cannot allocate that realm again.
fixtureCases.season_settlement_rejections: Empty name, pre-settling and ended clocks, and selected entry outside development reject without gameplay changes.
fixtureCases.season_settlement_occupied: Occupied initial planner positions are discarded with the original root and salt before a vacant candidate settles.
fixtureCases.season_ledger_pass: A bound owner with the wrong pass kind cannot settle.
fixtureCases.season_ledger_order: An entitlement with invalid Order rejects without gameplay mutations.
fixtureCases.season_ledger_empty: An entitlement without production traits rejects without gameplay mutations.
fixtureCases.season_wrong_mode: The Eternum entrypoint rejects a Blitz game.
fixtureCases.season_triple: Season settlement rejects the three-realm planner mode.
fixtureCases.season_duel: Season settlement rejects the duel planner mode.
fixtureCases.season_pre_main: Settlement succeeds at the settling boundary before main-game start, with immediate provisioning.
fixtureCases.season_explorer_occupied: Season placement skips an occupied explorer tile and leaves the explorer unchanged.
fixtureCases.season_search_limit: Sixty-four occupied candidate draws reject without committing allocation or planner changes.
fixtureCases.village: Village production and army grants use the same resources and recorded time; planner placement and pass consumption are the frozen new behaviour.

randomness.weightedChoiceSalt: block timestamp plus 18 before each selection

comparison.timestampContext: Identical recorded acceptance time and oracle block time.
metadataNormalization: Deployment and account addresses map bijectively to logical identities.
Native transport nonces and result records are not player-observable gameplay facts.
Entity ids identify the same logical fixture entities; storage bookkeeping and row/event encoding are not compared.

fixturePreparation.spires: One access fixture on each required portal; uses original map and biome helpers. Spire settlement is outside this slice.
fixturePreparation.production: A productive realm fixture starts with a configured building and finite output. The oracle claim adapter invokes the pinned SingleResourceStore settlement path with owner authorization.
fixturePreparation.recipes: Full pinned factory and building tables are installed without balance overrides.

derivedGameplayModels.LastBattle: Herald projects the matching BattleEvent for both participants, including deleted explorers.
